title: Use a native receiver whose real loaded moments are warranted
statement: For fixed continuous rows with independent row-translation symmetry and common within-row friction, summed nonlinear forces cancel in the exact metered row system. A deterministic loaded mean shift supplies bounded drift, bracket O(1/N) and ordinary second moments in the full physical filtration. Canonical work bounds follow from that moment supplier rather than from an LDP. Count-only fixed-loss records fail super-volume precision; actual tags and wrapped positions change the access and permit the separately scoped short-arc route.
